_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option lets you override generated goal parameters.
description: The goal of the randomizer.
Options for the final level include: bowers_fortified_fortress, the_ultimate_test, and the_perfect_run.
Also available is the star_hunt goal, which requires the collection of a chosen number of stars before completion.
Include Luigi as an item for unlock.
Note: Luigi's extra high jumps are currently not accounted for in logic.
How many stars are needed to goal with Star Hunt.
Minimum 1 star, maximum 122 stars. Default is 70 stars.
The expected difficulty of tricks by logic.
easy: Logic will only include simple, likely developer-intended strategies.
medium: Includes a number of unintended, but relatively easy, strategies, as well as generally more precise movement.
hard: Requires some difficult, obscure, or glitched strategies. While not requiring speedrunner-level knowledge,
make sure you're comfortable with the game.
Receive checks for collecting 1-Ups.
off: 1-Up locations will be disabled.
mushrooms_only: All 1-Up Mushrooms will be included.
all: In addition to mushrooms, the 1-Ups from collecting timed coins
from a ? coin and eating fruit with Yoshi will be included
Receive checks for collecting Life Mushrooms.
Receive checks for purchasing from Luma Shops.
Receive checks for spinning chance cubes.
Receive checks for reaching checkpoint flags.
Receive checks for collecting speedrun clocks.
Receive checks for collecting ? Coins.
Enable or disable regular Green Star locations.
Mario's movement abilities will be randomized. These are: Spin,
Backflip, Sideflip, Triple Jump, Wall Jump, Long Jump, and Ground Pound.
off: Mario's moveset will be unlocked from the start.
spin_start: Mario's moveset will be randomized, except for Spin.
full: All of Mario's moves will be randomized.
Whether Spin and Triple Jump will be split into two Progressive items.
Spin splits into only spinning on the ground and underwater, and then Air Spin.
Triple Jump splits into Double Jump, then Triple Jump.
When Spin Start is on, it will start with only one Progressive Spin.
Each galaxy will have its own comet medal item in the multiworld that locks access to its comets.
How Prankster Comet randomization will be handled.
off: Prankster Comets will be available from the start.
category: Prankster Comets will be randomized by type of comet.
combined: Prankster Comets will all be unlocked by a single item.
Access to Pull Stars, Star Balls, and Tornadoes will be randomized.
Access to power-ups will be randomized.
The number of stars needed to access Bowser's Galaxy Generator.
Default is 70 stars, maximum is 122 stars.
The number of stars needed to access Grandmaster Galaxy.
Default and maximum is 122 stars.
The number of green stars need to access Grandmaster Galaxy.
Only does something if Green Stars are enabled.
Maximum is 120, default is 0.
Receive checks for collecting Purple Coins. For sickos only.
